exercises.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect?
options: La tecnología ha cambiado nuestra forma de comunicarnos. [Technology has changed the way we communicate.]
La tecnología cambia nuestra forma de comunicarnos. [Technology changes the way we communicate.]
La tecnología cambiará nuestra forma de comunicarnos. [Technology will change the way we communicate.]

exercises.english: I have updated my device recently.
Many people have changed their communication habits.

sentences: Esta mañana he actualizado mi dispositivo. [This morning I have updated my device.]
Después he conectado el dispositivo a la red. [Then I have connected the device to the network.]
Por último, he enviado un mensaje a mi familia. [Finally, I have sent a message to my family.]

exercises.question: Which auxiliary is used in the present perfect?
options: haber [to have]
ser [to be]
estar [to be]

template.prompt: Say that technology has changed the way we communicate and that many people have changed their habits.
template.answer: La tecnología ha cambiado nuestra forma de comunicarnos y muchas personas han cambiado sus hábitos.
